svg.title: Tech stack
svg.desc: web: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, tRPC, TanStack Query, Zod, Better Auth; backend: PHP, WordPress, WooCommerce, Twig, .NET, Node.js, Bun; data: PostgreSQL, Drizzle, MySQL, Redis; firmware: C++, ESP-IDF, FreeRTOS, Arduino, PlatformIO; quant & ml: Python, PyTorch, NumPy, Pandas, Pydantic, TensorFlow; ship it: Docker, GitHub Actions, Vercel, Sentry, Vitest, Playwright, Git; make it: Fusion 360, Blender, PrusaSlicer, Prusa MK3S+, Prusa Mini+, Vertex K8400
